title: Review: SSE JSON depth fix + regression tests
notes:
Section 0 CORRECTNESS: NO FINDINGS. Fix path matches server emission in kithd/src/events.rs:438-441. Edge cases (invalid JSON, missing field, non-string value) all handled correctly by the option chain. Test oracles are independent of implementation.
Maintainer risk: LOW — patch is confined to one function body and three unit tests; no new public surface, no new wire contract, no security surface.
Confidence: 3% chance of missed bug. Uncertainty driven by: the fix being a client-side parse (kithctl), not a server protocol change — the server's emission shape was confirmed by reading kithd/src/events.rs:438-441 directly, so the path match is verified; however, there is no end-to-end integration test that drives an actual SSE frame through the TCP stack into kithctl's parse loop. Would raise confidence if: a watch_integration test existed that spun up kithd, sent a message, and confirmed a desktop notification fired. That test does not exist and is out of scope for this patch. The patch itself is correct.
